title: Borssele Nuclear Power Station
scope: Public-facing landmark massing in Zeeland: pale concrete dome, connected large industrial exterior hall and lower adjoining roof forms.
limitations: Approximate silhouette, divided roof forms and cladding, based on the mapped outer perimeter and public written descriptions.
The model covers the visible dome and connected major masses, with simplified window bands and a graded foundation.
Photographs, other premises and detailed site features were excluded.
